name: Constraint and Index Parity
description: Every constraint and index on SQLite must have an equivalent on PGlite. Verify with automated comparison.
acceptanceCriteria: Comparison script extracts all constraints from SQLite and PGlite
Comparison script extracts all indexes from SQLite and PGlite
Automated check reports any constraint or index missing in PGlite
Every discrepancy has an approved justification or is fixed
Constraint parity check is part of CI
